adopt-c-bounds-safety.summary: Apple guidance for adopting, reviewing, and debugging C -fbounds-safety, pointer bounds annotations, ptrcheck.h, compiler modes, and bounds violations.

app-intents-specialist.summary: Apple App Intents best practices for implementation and correctness review: execution, entities and queries, enums, parameters, dependencies, results, donation, localization, shortcut phrases, URLs, and configuration intents. Use the version-specific skill for new iOS 26/27 APIs.

app-intents-whats-new-27.summary: Adopt or migrate App Intents APIs introduced in iOS 26/27 and aligned platforms: execution modes, undo/cancellation, long-running intents, interactive snippets, Visual Intelligence, Spotlight, cross-device entities, computed properties, system shortcuts, unions, Apple Intelligence schemas, and testing. Use the specialist for evergreen best practices.

app-resizability.summary: Adapt app layouts to resizing and multiple windows, including foldable iPhone, split-screen, and Stage Manager. Replace legacy screen, orientation, idiom, lifecycle, and safe-area assumptions with window- and scene-specific APIs.

audit-xcode-security-settings.summary: Audit or enable Xcode compiler warnings, static analysis, and Enhanced Security build settings for C, C++, Objective-C, or Swift. Excludes network security, code signing, and privacy APIs.

building-document-based-swiftui-applicat.summary: Build or migrate SwiftUI document apps using the iOS 27 Document protocol: DocumentGroup, readers/writers, FileWrapper packages, file URLs, open/save/export, progress, undo, autosave, and UTType. Covers migration from FileDocument and ReferenceFileDocument.

swiftui-specialist.summary: Apple SwiftUI implementation and review guidance for animation, Environment and @Entry, Observation invalidation, ForEach/List identity and performance, localization, and soft-deprecated APIs. Consult matching references for affected code.

swiftui-whats-new-27.summary: Adopt or migrate SwiftUI 27 APIs: @State macro and ViewBuilder type-check changes, drag-to-reorder containers, AsyncImage caching, swipe actions outside List, toolbar overflow/pinning, and item-based confirmation dialogs or alerts. Use for version-specific changes or new API questions.
